title: Decide loyalty named-card choice capability

evidence.paragraph: Choose a nonland card name, then reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all cards with the chosen name from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

required_behavior: Return NEEDS_PRIMITIVE unless the packet proves existing named-card choice state, name filtering, and reveal-zone linkage.
gates: response is one structured verdict and contains no edit block
on_failure: Record only raw response and telemetry; no retry.
